skill.name: agent-tools
skill.description: Run inference.sh cloud AI apps from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code using the infsh CLI for image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and X/Twitter workflows.
skill.summary: Use the infsh CLI to discover and run inference.sh AI apps from an AI coding agent.
skill.author: inferencesh

security_audit.summary: Review confirmed multiple remote installer commands that pipe downloaded content directly into a shell, which is a critical supply-chain risk. Most API key, hidden file, documentation link, and system reconnaissance matches are benign reference material. The skill still carries elevated risk because it grants broad infsh command access and includes account-changing cloud and X/Twitter actions.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell setup with pinned package installation, checksum verification, or a signed release download before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill permits broad infsh command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed commands where possible and require explicit confirmation before running, deploying, pulling, or changing account state.

remediation.issue: X/Twitter examples can publish or interact from a user account.
remediation.suggestion: Add mandatory user confirmation before posts, messages, follows, likes, reposts, or any other public account action.

remediation.issue: Credential setup examples mention API keys.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to place real API keys in prompts, shared files, logs, or inline command history.

remediation.issue: Related skill installation commands expand the trusted surface.
remediation.suggestion: Mark related skill installs as optional manual steps and instruct users to review each skill before installation.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a local or marketplace-hosted image asset to avoid external render-time requests.

content.value_statement: Agents need one interface for many hosted AI models and media workflows. This skill teaches Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use the infsh CLI safely.
actual_capabilities: Install, update, and authenticate the infsh CLI.
List, search, filter, and inspect inference.sh apps.
Run AI apps with inline input or input files.
Track long-running tasks and save task results.
Use examples for images, videos, LLM calls, search, 3D, audio, and X/Twitter actions.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account and local infsh CLI access.
Cloud apps may require credits, provider permissions, or third-party credentials.
Generated media, search results, and model outputs depend on the selected app.
Installation guidance includes remote shell installer commands that require manual trust review.

use_cases.title: Prototype Media Generation
use_cases.description: Find image, video, audio, or 3D apps and run fast test jobs from the command line.

use_cases.title: Compare Hosted AI Models
use_cases.description: Discover LLM, search, and media apps, inspect schemas, and compare results across providers.

use_cases.title: Operate Account Workflows
use_cases.description: Use authenticated CLI commands for app runs, task tracking, deployment checks, and optional X/Twitter workflows.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find inference.sh apps for image generation. List strong options and explain what each one is best for before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create Sample Input
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the app google/veo-3-1-fast and create a sample input file. Explain which fields I should edit.

prompt_templates.title: Run And Track A Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an image generation task with my prompt, track it until completion, and summarize the returned media result.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a text-to-image app, prepare a prompt from my product brief, run the task, then collect supporting references with a search app. Ask before paid or publishing actions.

output_examples.input: Find a fast video model for a short product clip.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists relevant video apps, explains speed and quality tradeoffs, and recommends generating sample input first.

output_examples.input: Run an image generation task and save the result.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects an image app, prepares input, runs the task, reports completion, and points to the saved media result.

output: The assistant checks the app schema.

best_practices: Review remote installation commands before execution.
Use sample input and app details before running paid tasks.
Confirm X/Twitter, deployment, or credential-related actions with the account owner.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers to a shell without verification.
Do not run publishing or account actions without explicit approval.
Do not place real API keys in prompts, logs, or shared files.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI agent use the infsh CLI to discover, run, and track hosted inference.sh apps.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Most useful commands require infsh authentication and may require credits or provider credentials.

faq.question: Can it generate images or videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for FLUX image generation and Veo video generation through inference.sh apps.

faq.question: Can it post to X or Twitter?
faq.answer: Yes, if the relevant app and account credentials are configured. Users should confirm every publishing action first.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: The documentation uses remote installer commands that pipe downloaded content directly into a shell.
